citations.short: Buildings not maintained in good state of repair
citations.long: Buildings used in the manufacturing, processing, packing, and holding of a drug product are not maintained in a good state of repair.

citations.short: Label storage access limited to authorized personnel
citations.long: Access to the storage area for labels and labeling materials is not limited to authorized personnel.
Established laboratory control mechanisms are not followed and documented at the time of performance.

citations.short: Identification of Persons Performing Significant Steps
citations.long: The batch production and control records are deficient in that they do not include identification of persons performing and checking each significant step in the operation.

citations.short: Calculations performed are in the records
citations.long: Laboratory records do not include a record of all calculations performed in connection with the test.

citations.short: Contamination control, Lack of or inadequate procedures
citations.long: Procedures have not been defined to prevent contamination of equipment or product by certain substances.
Products that do not conform to specifications are not adequately controlled.
